description: This file is the main entry point of a Swift command-line application. It defines the CLI dispatch logic, handling subcommands like 'swabble', 'mic', 'service', etc., and routing them to respective command handlers. It sets up the program's execution flow, error handling, and version guard for macOS 26.0+.

methods.name: runCLI
methods.description: Main function that initializes CLI, resolves invocation, dispatches commands, and handles errors.

methods.name: dispatch
methods.description: Routes the primary command based on the first element of the command path.

methods.name: dispatchSwabble
methods.description: Handles subcommands specific to 'swabble', routing to further subcommands like 'mic', 'service', etc.

methods.name: swabbleHandlers
methods.description: Returns a dictionary mapping 'swabble' subcommands to their respective asynchronous handler functions.

methods.name: dispatchMic
methods.description: Handles subcommands related to 'mic', such as 'list' and 'set'.

methods.name: dispatchService
methods.description: Handles subcommands related to 'service', such as 'install', 'uninstall', and 'status'.

methods.name: subcommand
methods.description: Extracts a subcommand string from the command path at a given index, throwing errors if missing.
